title: Loom — Spectrogram Sound Painter
description: Paint on a spectrogram and hear it back: five brushes, scale snapping, six generators and a WAV you can download.
concept: Loom turns the usual direction of audio analysis around. Instead of looking at a spectrogram of a sound, you paint one — 64 time columns by 48 semitone rows — and an additive-synthesis engine reads the painting back as sound, one sine bank per row, with the painted amplitudes interpolated into a sample-accurate envelope. Five brushes (pencil, scale-aware chord, harmonic stack, spray, eraser) write into the grid, a scale selector snaps every stroke to a key, and four timbres plus texture, shimmer, echo and stereo-width controls shape the voice. Six generators fill the canvas with a pad, an arpeggio, rain, a siren, birdsong or a bell choir, and anything you make exports as a 16-bit stereo .wav, a poster PNG, a JSON project or a shareable link.
features: Five brushes: pencil, chord (snapped to the chosen scale), harmonic stack, spray and eraser, with size and strength
Pitch grid with seven scales and twelve roots — off-scale rows dim and strokes snap to the nearest scale row
Additive render engine: four timbres (sine, reed, hollow, inharmonic glass) plus texture detune, shimmer tremolo, feedback echo and pitch-mapped stereo width
Six seeded generators (chord pad, arpeggio, rain, siren, birdsong, bell choir) with a re-roll for new variations
Transport with loop, animated playhead, live RMS meter and an instant preview ping on every stroke
Export a 16-bit stereo WAV, a poster PNG, a JSON project, or copy a link that carries the whole painting in its hash
Three save slots plus automatic restore of your last painting, 24-step undo and keyboard shortcuts
tech: Additive synthesis written straight into a Float32Array
Inharmonic partial sets and detuned copies for texture
In-place feedback delay and tremolo passes

interaction.mouse: Drag across the grid to paint sound; each stroke pings the note under the pointer so you hear it immediately.
interaction.click: Pick a brush, scale, timbre or generator; press Play to render and hear the whole painting; export WAV, PNG, JSON or a link.
interaction.touch: Single-finger painting with pointer capture; the panel stacks under the canvas and the whole app fits a phone with no horizontal scroll.
interaction.keyboard: Space plays and stops, 1–5 pick brushes, Z undoes, C clears, L toggles loop, G re-runs the last generator.
